subject: PO metadata ask + net60 conditional discount request
messages:

To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>; procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing / PO metadata / net terms question

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the updated quote — we reviewed with procurement. A couple of procurement constraints before we can generate the PO:

- We require the PO to reference our internal cost-center code (CC-5632) at the line-item level.
- Invoices must be issued monthly and tied to the PO number; some of our systems prefer one invoice per BU per month.
- Our standard terms are net60. Given the enterprise scale here (multi-BU pilot), can Redwood accommodate net60? If not, is there an alternate pricing/discount structure we can consider (e.g., early-pay discount or partial upfront)?

We need this clarified to route the PO to our AP team. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Cheers,
Liam

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing / PO metadata / net terms question

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and options below. I'm copying Vanessa (AE) and Karthik (Finance) so we have alignment.

1) PO line-item cost-center (CC-5632)
   - We can include a PO line-item field and pass it through on our invoice lines. Please confirm whether you want the cost-center repeated per SKU or only at the invoice header. We support both but need to know for CSV mapping.

2) Monthly invoices, one per BU
   - We can emit separate monthly invoices per business unit if you provide BU-level PO numbers or a mapping file. I attached our billing-instructions-template.xlsx to show the fields we can accept (PO, BU, cost-center, project code).

3) Net60 request / pricing impact
   - Standard hosted terms are net30. For net60 we typically require a credit approval and a pricing adjustment. Two paths that work operationally:
     a) Approve net60 with a 2.5% financing surcharge across invoice totals (applies while on net60).
     b) Keep net30, but provide a 1.5% early-pay discount if NovusHealth pays within 15 days for a 6-month pilot (auto-applied).

We're open to negotiating: Vanessa, can we flag whether we have room on list pricing to offer a smaller surcharge or trade the surcharge for a committed minimum spend that could unlock a 4% discount? Karthik, what internal approvals would net60 require?

Next steps: If you can confirm preference (surcharge vs early-pay vs committed discount), we'll produce a formal quote (updated RDW-Quote-NVH-v2.pdf) and sample invoices so your AP can validate mapping.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: billing-instructions-template.xlsx (stub), RDW-Quote-NVH-v2.pdf (stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing / PO metadata / net terms question

Thanks Naomi and Liam for the context. Internal notes:

- Account: NovusHealth is mid-enterprise with potential to expand across 4 BUs next year.
- Commercial levers: we can flex list price by up to ~4% for a committed 12-month pilot or provide a capped surcharge for extended terms.
- Recommendation to protect cash/ARR: prefer early-pay discount (1.5%) tied to a 6-month pilot. Offers the customer a visible saving without requiring approval for net60.

If customer insists on net60, I'd rather structure as: net60 + 1.5% surcharge but with an option to retroactively remove the surcharge if they close a 12-month commitment at a defined ARR threshold. That creates an upsell path.

Karthik — can you confirm whether Finance can sign off on that conditional removal path and whether we need Legal to add a clause? Also note: we must ensure our billing system will emit separate invoices per BU if we get BU identifiers up-front.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing / PO metadata / net terms question

Vanessa — Finance perspective:

- Net60 is not our preferred default for new accounts because of cashflow and credit exposure, but we can provisionally approve net60 with a small surcharge (1.5–2.5%). 1.5% would be on the lower end and requires a credit review; 2.5% is our standard for extended terms.
- The conditional removal of surcharge on hitting a committed ARR threshold is acceptable, but Legal needs to sign off on the language and we should require proof of BU activation (active usage + invoiced value) to trigger the removal.
- On PO metadata and multiple invoices: operationally feasible. We need procurement to provide a CSV mapping the BU codes to PO numbers before the pilot starts. AP prefers mapping file nightly upload or SFTP for automated reconciliation — otherwise manual mapping will delay payments.

I'll loop in Legal once we get customer's preference. Vanessa, if you want to propose 1.5% surcharge with the ARR-removal trigger, Finance can draft the required clause and the acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing / PO metadata / net terms question

Naomi — thanks for the clear options and Vanessa/Karthik for the internal review. Procurement met this morning and here's where we landed:

- NovusHealth preference: net60 (standard). We understand the financing cost; we'd accept a 1.5% surcharge for the 6-month pilot only.
- We can provide a BU-to-PO mapping CSV ahead of the pilot kickoff. We'll also include the cost-center CC-5632 on each line.
- Regarding conditional removal of surcharge: we can agree to a clause that removes the surcharge if we convert to a 12-month commitment at or above the agreed ARR threshold within the pilot window. Procurement will want the specific ARR number in the contract.

Next steps from our side: I'll share the mapping CSV by Friday and approve the updated quote once the surcharge/clause language is included. Please send the revised quote and the draft clause for Legal review.

Appreciate the flexible approach.

Best,
Liam
